data.title: Donate to Pittsburgh's Cat & Dog Rescue
data.subtitle: Every dollar goes directly to caring for rescued cats and dogs in the Pittsburgh region. As an all-volunteer organization, we have no salaries — your gift becomes vet care, vaccines, food, and forever homes.

data.title: Monetary Donation
paragraphs: Your financial gift directly supports veterinary care, food, shelter, and the rescue of animals in need. All donations are tax-deductible.

data.title: Donate Supplies
paragraphs: In-kind donations help us care for animals daily. Drop off supplies at our headquarters during thrift shop hours.

data.title: Current Wishlist
items: Dry cat food (Cat: Purina Tender Selects or Purina One Chicken)
Canned cat food (Fancy Feast or Friskies)
Adult cat litter (clumping, unscented brands of clay litter)
Paper towels and cleaning supplies (Rescue Brand Disinfectant, unscented dish soap and unscented laundry detergent)

data.title: Recurring Donations
data.text: Set up a monthly gift to provide steady support for our rescue operations year-round.

data.title: Honor & Memorial Gifts
data.text: Make a donation in honor or memory of a loved one or beloved pet.

data.title: Amazon Wishlist
data.text: Shop our Amazon wishlist to send supplies directly to our rescue.

data.title: 501(c)(3) Tax-Deductible
data.text: Animal Advocates is a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. All donations are tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law. EIN available upon request.

data.title: Max's Second Chance
paragraphs: "Thanks to donor support, we were able to provide Max with the emergency surgery he needed after being found injured. Today, he's thriving in his forever home with a loving family in the South Side."
